contract: docs/device-trace/CONTRACT.md v1 (PR #83, proposed; implemented as written, no field changed)

emitted.meaning: two 20-instruction mark blocks, empty kernel between

results.disabled_identity: PASS (byte-for-byte copy of the input words, no prologue, no stores)

instruction_slice: ISETP.GE.AND P0, PT, R0, 0x1, PT -- select thread 0 only
@P0 BRA past the block -- non-selected lanes never reach the stores; no barrier used for ordering
LDCU.64 UR4, c[0x0][0x358] -- global memory descriptor
S2R R2, SR_GLOBALTIMERLO -- device clock, low 32 bits
IMAD.SHL record address base + 0x40 (site 1) / 0x80 (site 2); IMAD.MOV high half copy
8 x STG.E dwords: site, kind, sequence, raw stamp, generation (2), kernel (2)
limitations: Record fields cta/warp/lane/payload stay zero and generation/kernel come from the constant bank; the host must zero the extent and initialise the header before launch, then finalise status after completion.

Runtime overflow is not exercised: exactly two fixed records are emitted, so a capacity below two is refused at emission (code 1) instead of dropping at runtime. Dynamic sequence counting, saturating dropped counters and partial status need the next slice.
Record offsets are added to the low 32 bits of the trace base with no carry propagation: the host buffer must not cross a 4 GiB boundary at any record offset.

Clock units, resolution, cross-SM comparability and CPU correlation are UNKNOWN. GLOBALTIMER low 32 bits is a reference, not a qualified 64-bit clock; wrap is 2^32 ticks and any interval at or beyond 2^31 ticks is ambiguous and must be refused by the consumer.
The enabled path is gated: gtewrap refuses with code 4 unless the host sets gtchecks, so no launch can use it before the chip checks exist.
No barrier, fence or wait was added. Marker order is issue order, not completion order; markers around a region do not prove the region completed between them.
One selected lane of one CTA is not representative of other lanes, warps or CTAs.

not_run.GB10_execution: NOT_RUN - no hardware window requested or granted
